content.value_statement: China market launches can fail when public claims exceed verified product evidence. This skill creates localized Chinese messaging and a launch plan that keeps claims, channels, and buyer expectations aligned.
actual_capabilities: Builds an evidence ledger for proposed public claims and safe wording.
Creates Chinese positioning directions with English back translations.
Drafts a Chinese landing page with separate internal evidence notes.
Recommends WeChat and Xiaohongshu content only when the channel fits the buyer.
Writes bilingual sales emails and evidence-safe answers to buyer objections.
Produces a fourteen-day implementation checklist with launch gates.
limitations: It cannot verify private product facts without current primary sources from the user.
It provides informational guidance, not legal, tax, regulatory, or trademark advice.
It does not test mainland network access, payment routes, or procurement processes.
It prepares drafts and instructions but does not publish content or create accounts.

use_cases.title: Prepare an enterprise China launch pack
use_cases.description: Create positioning, landing-page copy, WeChat content, procurement responses, and launch gates for an enterprise SaaS offer.

use_cases.title: Localize a developer product
use_cases.description: Adapt technical value statements, documentation entry points, and integration proof for Chinese developer buyers.

use_cases.title: Plan agency client localization
use_cases.description: Turn verified client facts into Chinese copy, bilingual outreach, and a clear implementation checklist.

prompt_templates.title: Start with a homepage
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this homepage copy to create a China launch pack. Identify missing evidence and write a Chinese landing page for small business owners: [paste copy].

prompt_templates.title: Create enterprise positioning
prompt_templates.prompt: Create three Chinese positioning directions for our enterprise SaaS. Use only these verified facts: [facts]. Our target buyer is [buyer], and our desired action is [CTA].

prompt_templates.title: Draft channel content
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess whether WeChat and Xiaohongshu fit this SaaS product. Then draft only the channels that fit, using this evidence ledger: [ledger].

prompt_templates.title: Audit launch claims
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this China launch draft for unsupported claims about compliance, hosting, payments, support, customers, and mainland access. Return safe replacements and launch blockers: [draft].

output_examples.input: A project management SaaS has English case studies but no verified China support details.
output: Evidence ledger that keeps case studies pending until sources are confirmed.
Chinese landing-page copy focused on team coordination rather than unsupported local support claims.
Launch gates for mainland access, data documentation, and procurement readiness.

output_examples.input: A developer API product wants to reach Chinese engineering teams.
output: Three Chinese positioning directions with English back translations.
Developer-focused content recommendations based on verifiable integration details.
Bilingual first-contact and follow-up sales emails with visible research placeholders.

best_practices: Provide current official sources for every public claim before requesting final copy.
Name the primary Chinese buyer and the single desired action before selecting channels.
Treat network access, data handling, and procurement readiness as launch gates until verified.
anti_patterns: Do not claim China compliance, local hosting, or Chinese support without direct evidence.
Do not use Xiaohongshu for narrow enterprise procurement products without a credible practitioner angle.
Do not present inferred benefits or user-provided facts as verified customer-facing proof.

faq.question: Does this skill translate my website word for word?
faq.answer: No. It adapts buying logic, proof order, examples, and calls to action for the intended Chinese buyer.

faq.question: What information should I provide first?
faq.answer: Provide your product URL or homepage copy, target buyer, verified proof, delivery constraints, and desired action.

faq.question: Can it claim that my product is compliant in China?
faq.answer: Only when you provide current direct evidence. Otherwise it marks the claim for qualified review.

faq.question: Will it recommend Xiaohongshu?
faq.answer: Only when individual users or practitioners can genuinely experience and discuss the product.

faq.question: Can it publish content or open platform accounts?
faq.answer: No. It prepares drafts and implementation instructions only.

faq.question: Does it verify mainland network access?
faq.answer: No. It identifies network access as a launch gate until current direct evidence is available.
